Class ChildPosition

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.toolkit.element.ChildPosition
public final class ChildPosition extends Object
Represents the position of a child element within its parent.

This is used with RenderContext.childStyle(String, ChildPosition) to enable CSS pseudo-class matching based on position, such as :first-child, :last-child, and :nth-child(even/odd).

Example usage: 

for (int i = 0; i < rows.size(); i++) {
    ChildPosition pos = ChildPosition.of(i, rows.size());
    Style rowStyle = context.childStyle("row", pos);
    // CSS can now match :first-child, :last-child, :nth-child(even), etc.
}
